preregistration: VGC-style opponent-diversity scaling — D1/D3/D7 set definition and budget
frozen_before: any D1 or D3 training run exists
research_question: How does increasing opponent-strategy diversity affect PPO generalization and robustness in maritime multi-agent CTF, and do population-based methods handle that diversity better than standard PPO?

not_gated_by_C4_C7.statement: C4-C7 are diagnostic evidence, NOT a stop gate for this experiment.
not_gated_by_C4_C7.why: C4-C7 asked whether response-ranking reversals exist. This asks how generalization scales with opponent diversity. A broad PPO generalist performing well is a VALID and interesting result here.
not_gated_by_C4_C7.use: C4-C7 become explanatory material AFTER primary performance results exist (Phase 18).

the_predeclared_selection_rule.rule: Rank OP6-OP12 by measured offensive_pressure from artifacts/c7_stage1/C7_STAGE1_RESULT.json (mean over the three 4v4 policies). D1 = the MEDIAN opponent. D3 = {minimum, median, maximum}. D7 = all seven.
the_predeclared_selection_rule.why_this_source: those measurements are already frozen, predate this experiment, and describe opponent MECHANICS. They are not a function of any D1/D3/D7 performance result, so the sets cannot be chosen to flatter an outcome.
the_predeclared_selection_rule.why_median_for_D1: so the single-opponent condition is not accidentally an extreme specialist, which would confound 'low diversity' with 'unusual opponent'.
the_predeclared_selection_rule.why_extremes_plus_median_for_D3: maximum behavioural spread on the one quantitative axis this project has already frozen, rather than a subset chosen by eye.
the_predeclared_selection_rule.nesting: D1 subset of D3 subset of D7, so the ladder varies diversity while holding the included behaviours cumulative.

held_out_opponents.note: every policy is evaluated against the FULL board regardless. The generalization gap is seen-average minus held-out-average; it is undefined for D7 by construction, which is expected and must be reported as such rather than as a zero.

budget_control.rule: identical total interaction budget across D1, D3 and D7. Diversity is the research variable, not training exposure.
budget_control.why_that_number: inherited from the frozen G0-V5 protocol, so the existing D7 runs are directly comparable without retraining
budget_control.explicitly_not: D7 does NOT get 7x the budget for having 7 opponents
budget_control.wall_clock: metadata only, never a comparison variable

team_size.why: G0-V5 (seeds 3200001-3) is already Mixed-PPO D7 at 2v2 under this exact protocol, so the D7 rung of the ladder EXISTS and needs no retraining. 4v4 D7 also exists (C7 seeds 3300001-3) and may be reported as a secondary team-size check.
team_size.constraint: all three rungs must share one team size for comparability

training_method.mechanism: the existing trainer, unchanged: mode=OPPONENT_POOL with cfg.opponent_pool set to the diversity set
training_method.sampling: uniform per COMPLETED episode, deterministic under cfg.seed, no mid-episode switching
training_method.no_new_code: verified in the Phase 1 audit; D1/D3/D7 differ only by pool contents

evaluation.protocol: every policy against the FULL OP6-OP12 board under one frozen protocol
evaluation.reversals: may be reported as a diagnostic; NOT required for the experiment to proceed

outcomes_are_all_publishable.A: D1 strong locally, weak held-out -> specialization/generalization tradeoff
outcomes_are_all_publishable.B: D7 strong across the board -> standard PPO absorbs substantial diversity (valid positive)
outcomes_are_all_publishable.C: FP/self-play improve worst-case robustness -> supports population training
outcomes_are_all_publishable.D: Mixed ~ FP ~ self-play -> population methods add little here (still useful)
outcomes_are_all_publishable.E: performance falls as D1->D3->D7 -> VGC-style evidence that diversity makes learning harder
outcomes_are_all_publishable.F: performance stable as diversity increases -> maritime CTF differs from VGC-Bench's pattern

prohibited: changing D1 or D3 membership after seeing final performance
giving D7 a larger budget because it has more opponents
creating OP13 or any new opponent
modifying map_a, RULESET_V2, or any OP6-OP12 profile
requiring a ranking reversal for the experiment to continue
starting SRCTF work under this experiment
immutability: After any D1 or D3 training number exists, the sets, budget, team size and evaluation protocol may not change.
